label: New base rate count
summary: A number from the treasury budget change window that, going by its name, counts something at the base rate in the new budget.
details: It takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it, so what is passed and what exactly is counted is not shown.

label: New budget capacity
summary: The treasury budget capacity (the monthly treasury amount available for budgeting) that the budget would have with the planned changes.
details: Vanilla shows it in the budget change window as the "Current" capacity, followed by the change from the previous value (GetBudgetCapacityDiff).

label: New receiver count
summary: A whole number shown for each law group in the budget change window; going by its name, how many receive money from it under the new budget.
details: It takes one argument: vanilla passes the law group of the row (GuiLawGroup.Self).

label: New budget surplus
summary: The part of the planned budget that is left over (unallocated); below zero it is a deficit.
details: Vanilla shows the amount under the label "Unallocated", or "Deficit" when it is below zero, and shows a deficit warning text then.

label: New law group total
summary: The total amount shown for one law group in the planned budget.
details: It takes one argument: vanilla passes the law group of the row (GuiLawGroup.Self) and shows the amount with the treasury icon in that row.

label: New budget total
summary: The total sum of the planned budget.
details: Vanilla shows it with the treasury icon in the summary of the budget change window, next to the change from the previous value (GetBudgetTotalSumDiff).

label: Budget title
summary: A title that the budget change window is about; the window reads the title's holder from it.
details: Vanilla makes it the context of the whole window and takes the holder from it (GetTitle.GetHolder) for a part at the top. The game documents no return type, and which title it is, is not shown.

label: Change cost breakdown
summary: A text describing the full cost of enacting the budget change.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tooltip under the heading "Total Cost"; the short form is GetTotalChangeCostShort.

label: Change cost
summary: A short text with the cost of enacting the budget change.
details: Vanilla shows it as "Cost: …" in the button area of the window; the longer breakdown (GetTotalChangeCostDescription) is the tooltip of that line.

label: Raise law group budget
summary: Going by its name, raises the budget step of one law group in the planned budget.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in each law group row, passes that law group (GuiLawGroup.AccessSelf) and enables it with CanIncreaseBudgetGroupLaw. The row also shows the currently selected law of the group between this button and a matching decrease button, so it likely moves to the next law; the exact step is not shown.

label: Budget change window itself
summary: A function on the treasury budget change window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types (such as Character.Self) is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access triggered legend seed
summary: A function on a triggered legend seed that, going by its name, hands back the seed itself.
details: A triggered legend seed is something the legends window lets a character create (see CanCreateTriggeredLegend). Vanilla never names AccessSelf on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Triggered legend description
summary: The description text of a triggered legend seed, for a given character.
details: It takes one argument, the character it is for: vanilla passes Character.Self. Vanilla shows it at the start of the tooltip for creating the legend and under the name in the seed's header tooltip.

label: Triggered legend name
summary: The name of a triggered legend seed, for a given character.
details: It takes one argument, the character it is for: vanilla passes Character.Self. Vanilla shows it in the legends window and as the header of the seed's tooltip.

label: Name with protagonist
summary: The name of a triggered legend seed with a protagonist (the legend's hero) filled in, going by its name.
details: It takes two arguments. Vanilla never uses it on this type; LegendSeed.GetNameWithProtagonist gets a character and the chosen protagonist, which is only a hint for this one.

label: Legend seed
summary: The legend seed that a triggered legend seed is based on.
details: Vanilla makes it the context of part of the legends window and reads the creation cost for a character from it (GetSeed.GetCreationCost).

label: Is shown
summary: Whether a triggered legend seed is shown, going by its name.
details: It takes one argument, not shown in vanilla, which never uses it on this type. The same name on other types decides whether a GUI element is visible; that is only a hint.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether a triggered legend seed is valid, going by its name.
details: It takes one argument, not shown in vanilla, which never uses it on this type. The game documents nothing more; IsValidDescription may be the matching text, which is a guess from the names.

label: Validity text
summary: A text on a triggered legend seed that, going by its name, describes whether it is valid.
details: It takes one argument; vanilla never uses it.

label: Triggered legend seed itself
summary: The triggered legend seed itself, to pass on to other functions.
details: Vanilla passes it to Character.CanCreateTriggeredLegend (whether the character may create it), to Character.GetCanCreateTriggeredLegendDesc in the creation tooltip, and to the button that opens the legend creation view. The game documents no return type.

label: Access troop item
summary: A function on a troop item (a line of troops in the army view) that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Troop tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for one line of troops in an army.
details: It takes one argument, the army: vanilla passes Army.Self in the army view's troop tooltip.

label: Troop count
summary: The number of troops in one line of troops of an army.
details: Vanilla shows it as a number next to the line's icon in the army window and in a tooltip.

label: Troop maximum
summary: Going by its name, the most soldiers a line of troops can have.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; army regiment texts show count/maximum with a GetMax of their own, which is only a hint, and the other type is not this one.

label: Troop name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a line of troops in an army.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetName is common on other types and only a hint.

label: Troop regiment
summary: The regiment behind a line of troops.
details: Vanilla goes on from it (GetRegiment.GetRegiment.GetMAAType.GetIcon) to the icon of the men-at-arms type in the army window and in a tooltip. The game documents no return type.

label: Is knights
summary: Whether a line of troops is the army's knights.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the knight icon in the army window and in a tooltip.

label: Is levies
summary: Whether a line of troops is levies (the ordinary soldiers raised from the realm).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the levies icon in the army window and in a tooltip.

label: Is men-at-arms
summary: Whether a line of troops is a men-at-arms regiment (trained professional soldiers).
details: Vanilla uses it to show the men-at-arms icon in the army window and in a tooltip.

label: Troop item itself
summary: A function on a troop item that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tutorial
summary: A function on the tutorial that, going by its name, hands back the tutorial itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Can replay voiceover
summary: Whether the current tutorial step's voiceover can be played again, going by its name.
details: Vanilla never uses it; ReplayVoiceover is the action and GetReplayVoiceoverTooltip its tooltip.

label: Replay voiceover tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text for replaying the tutorial voiceover.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Step header info
summary: An extra text shown in parentheses in the tutorial window, next to the header of the current step.
details: Vanilla hides the line when the text is empty. What the text contains is not shown in the input.

label: Step instructions
summary: The instructions text of the current tutorial step.
details: Vanilla shows them in the tutorial window only when the step has some (HasStepInstructions).

label: Step name
summary: The name of the current tutorial step.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tutorial window.

label: Step text
summary: The main text of the current tutorial step.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tutorial window.

label: Transition text
summary: The button text for one way out of the current tutorial step.
details: It takes the transition's key as text: vanilla passes keys such as 'back', 'full_tutorial_explanation' and 'quick_tutorial_explanation'.

label: Transition tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip for one way out of the current tutorial step.
details: It takes one argument, likely the transition's key as with GetTransitionText; vanilla never uses it.

label: Has step instructions
summary: Whether the current tutorial step has instructions.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the instructions part of the tutorial window.

label: Has transition
summary: Whether the current tutorial step has a given way out.
details: It takes the transition's key as text. Vanilla uses 'read_later', 'full_tutorial_explanation', 'back', 'repeat', 'skip' and 'next', and shows each tutorial button only when its transition exists.

label: Is transition enabled
summary: Whether a given way out of the current tutorial step can be clicked now.
details: It takes the transition's key as text, such as 'read_later', 'back' or 'repeat'. Vanilla enables the matching button with it.

label: Take transition
summary: Takes a given way out of the current tutorial step, as when its button is clicked.
details: It takes the transition's key as text, such as 'read_later', 'back' or 'repeat'.

label: Replay voiceover
summary: Going by its name, plays the current tutorial step's voiceover again.
details: Vanilla never uses it; CanReplayVoiceover is the matching check.

label: Tutorial itself
summary: A function on the tutorial that, going by its name, hands back the tutorial itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Should be visible
summary: Whether the tutorial window should be shown now.
details: Vanilla shows the tutorial widget only when this is true and the barbershop (the appearance editor) is not open.

label: Access tutorial window
summary: A function on the tutorial window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Close tutorial window
summary: Going by its name, closes the tutorial window.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; the lines found for the name are ordinary words in texts.

label: Tutorial window itself
summary: A function on the tutorial window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Tweakable itself
summary: A tweakable (a setting of the engine's tweaker tool) itself, handed over so another function can change it.
details: The tweaker passes it to ResetTweakable, so the reset button sets the setting back to its starting value. Self is the read-only counterpart. The game documents no return type.

label: Tweakable on/off value
summary: The on/off value of a yes/no setting in the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it as the checked state of the setting's checkbox.

label: Tweakable color
summary: The color value of a color setting in the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it in the setting's color picker. Its type is a vector of four numbers.

label: Tweakable description
summary: Going by its name, the description of a tweakable setting.
details: Part of the engine's internal tweaker tool; vanilla never uses it on this type.

label: Tweakable button name
summary: The name shown on the button of a callback setting (one that runs something) in the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it as the text of the button next to the setting's text box.

label: Tweakable ID
summary: The identifier of a setting in the engine's tweaker tool, as text.
details: The tweaker shows it in the tooltip of the setting's name, with a note that right-clicking copies the ID to the clipboard.

label: Tweakable value
summary: The current value of a setting in the engine's tweaker tool, as text.
details: The tweaker shows it in the text box of number, text, color and callback settings; OnValueEdited takes in what is typed there.

label: Value edited
summary: Runs when the value in a setting's box of the engine's tweaker tool has been edited; it returns nothing.
details: The tweaker runs it when editing of the setting's text box ends with a change. It takes no argument.

label: Tweakable itself
summary: A setting of the engine's tweaker tool itself, handed over to be read.
details: The tweaker passes it to CanResetTweakable to show the reset button only when a reset is possible, and to GetTweakableOriginalValue for the button's tooltip. AccessSelf is the counterpart used for the reset itself. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tweakable category
summary: A function on a category of the engine's tweaker tool that, going by its name, hands back the category itself.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Category indent
summary: The left margin (indent) of a category's header in the engine's tweaker tool, as a whole number.
details: The tweaker uses it as the left margin of the category's header.

label: Category name
summary: The name of a category in the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it in bold in the category's header.

label: Is category expanded
summary: Whether a category in the engine's tweaker tool is opened up to show its settings (yes or no).
details: The tweaker shows it as the state of the expand button in the category's header; ToggleExpanded opens or closes it.

label: Tweakable category itself
summary: A function on a category of the tweaker tool that, going by its name, hands back the category itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type.

label: Open or close category
summary: Opens a closed category of the engine's tweaker tool, or closes an open one; it returns nothing.
details: The category's expand button runs it, followed by RebuildTree, which redraws the whole list.

label: Access tweaker entry
summary: A function on an entry of the tweaker tool's list that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Setting display name
summary: The readable name of a setting as listed in the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it as the setting's title in each row; hovering it shows the setting's ID.

label: Setting indent
summary: The left margin (indent) of a setting's row in the engine's tweaker tool, as a whole number.
details: The tweaker adds 5 to it and uses the sum as the left margin of the setting's row.

label: Tweaker entry itself
summary: A function on an entry of the tweaker tool's list that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type.

label: Access tweaker
summary: A function on the tweaker (going by its name, an engine tool for tweaking settings) that hands back the tweaker itself.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Can reset setting
summary: Whether the given setting in the engine's tweaker tool can be reset to its starting value (yes or no).
details: It takes one value: the setting. The tweaker shows a setting's reset button only when this is true; ResetTweakable does the reset.

label: Clear filter
summary: Empties the filter text of the engine's tweaker tool; it returns nothing.
details: The tweaker runs it from the small Clear Text button inside the filter box.

label: Filter text
summary: The text currently typed into the filter box of the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows it in the filter box; SetSearchString takes in what is typed there.

label: Selected category
summary: The name of the category selected in the engine's tweaker tool, so that only its settings are shown.
details: The tweaker compares it with each category button's name to show the selected one as pressed; ToggleSelectedCategory changes it.

label: Original setting value
summary: The starting value of the given setting in the engine's tweaker tool, as text.
details: It takes one value: the setting. The tweaker shows it in the reset button's tooltip: "Reset variable to initial value: '…'".

label: Tweaker options
summary: What runs when the Tweaker Options button of the engine's tweaker tool is pressed; it returns nothing.
details: The tweaker runs it from a settings-icon button with the tooltip "Tweaker Options". What the options are is not shown in the files.

label: Rebuild tree
summary: Builds the list of categories and settings of the engine's tweaker tool anew; it returns nothing.
details: The tweaker runs it after a category is opened or closed; the file's comment says rebuilding the whole tree is easier and quite fast.

label: Reset setting
summary: Sets the given setting of the engine's tweaker tool back to its starting value; it returns nothing.
details: It takes one value: the setting. The tweaker runs it from the setting's reset button, which shows only when CanResetTweakable is true.

label: Top categories
summary: The names of the top-level categories of the engine's tweaker tool.
details: The tweaker shows them as a grid of buttons, four per row, each selecting one category; one named Uncategorized is hidden. The game documents no return type.

label: Tweaker itself
summary: A function on the tweaker that, going by its name, hands back the tweaker itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type.

label: Set filter
summary: Takes in the text typed into the filter box of the engine's tweaker tool; it returns nothing.
details: The tweaker runs it each time the text in the filter box changes. It takes no value: the text comes from the box itself.

label: Select category
summary: Selects the given category in the engine's tweaker tool so only its settings are shown, or unselects it; it returns nothing.
details: It takes one value: the category's name. The tweaker runs it from each category button, whose tooltip says it limits the results to that category.

label: Access object
summary: A function on an internal engine GUI type the game names only "Type" that, going by its name, hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The other functions of this type (mesh, layer, render pass, water level) seem to point to an internal editor for placed objects.

label: Delete object
summary: Going by its name, deletes the object of this internal engine type.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type. The type is named only "Type" in the game's list; its other functions (mesh, layer, render pass, water level) seem to belong to an internal object editor.

label: Asset name
summary: Going by its name, the name of the asset (graphics file) the object uses.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it on this type.

label: Entity index
summary: Going by its name, an index pair for the object's entity (its 3D model setup).
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; it returns two whole numbers. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Instance count
summary: Going by its name, how many copies of the object exist.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Layer entry key
summary: The key (identifier) of the entry behind an item of the map editor's layer tree.
details: The engine's map editor reaches it through a layer tree item (`LayerTreeItem.GetEntry.GetKey`) and shows it after a label such as Mesh, Entity, Locator or Generated. What kind of object the entry is is not documented beyond those labels.

label: Layer
summary: Going by its name, the name of the layer the object is on.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Layer index
summary: Going by its name, an index pair for the object's layer.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; it returns two whole numbers. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Mesh index
summary: Going by its name, an index pair for the object's mesh (3D model).
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; it returns two whole numbers. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Render pass
summary: Going by its name, the drawing stage the object is drawn in.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Type index
summary: Going by its name, an index pair for the object's type.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; it returns two whole numbers. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Is hidden
summary: Going by its name, whether the object is hidden.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Is locked
summary: Going by its name, whether the object is locked against changes.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it on this type.

label: Is selected
summary: Going by its name, whether the object is selected.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it on this type.

label: Rename object
summary: Going by its name, renames the object.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Object itself
summary: A function on an internal engine type named only "Type" that, going by its name, hands back the object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type.

label: Set water level clamp
summary: Going by its name, sets whether the object is kept at water level.
details: It takes one argument, likely on or off; ShouldClampToWaterLevel reads it back. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set entity from index
summary: Going by its name, sets the object's entity (3D model setup) from the chosen index.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Set layer from index
summary: Going by its name, sets the object's layer from the chosen index.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Set mesh from index
summary: Going by its name, sets the object's mesh (3D model) from the chosen index.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Set render pass
summary: Going by its name, sets the drawing stage the object is drawn in.
details: It takes one argument, likely the stage; vanilla never uses it.

label: Set type from index
summary: Going by its name, sets the object's type from the chosen index.
details: Part of an internal engine type named only "Type"; vanilla never uses it.

label: Clamps to water level
summary: Going by its name, whether the object is kept at water level.
details: SetClampToWaterLevel changes it. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Access unassigned vassal list
summary: A function on the list of vassals not yet assigned to a tax jurisdiction that, going by its name, hands back the list itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Clear selection
summary: Unselects all vassals picked in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in the tax jurisdiction's vassal window (where a tax collector's taxpayers are chosen).

label: Vassal levies
summary: The levies figure of one vassal in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: It takes one argument, the vassal's row: vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self and shows the number after the soldier icon.

label: Selected vassals
summary: The vassals picked in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: Vanilla counts them in the text "… vassals are assigned as taxpayers in this tax jurisdiction" and enables the assign button only when there are some. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassal taxable income
summary: The taxable income of one vassal in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: It takes one argument, the vassal's row: vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self and shows the gold amount with two decimals.

label: Is vassal selected
summary: Whether a given vassal is picked in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: It takes one argument, the vassal's row (CharacterListItem.Self). Vanilla uses it to show the row as pressed and to show a selection mark.

label: Select all vassals
summary: Picks every vassal in the list of unassigned vassals.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in the tax jurisdiction's vassal window; ClearSelectedCharacters does the opposite.

label: Unassigned vassal list itself
summary: A function on the list of unassigned vassals that, going by its name, hands back the list itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access undo history
summary: A function on an undo stack (a history of changes that can be undone) that, going by its name, hands back the stack itself.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Clear undo history
summary: Going by its name, empties the undo history.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; IsClearable is the matching check.

label: Can clear history
summary: Going by its name, whether the undo history can be emptied.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Can redo
summary: Whether there is an undone change in the engine's tools that can be done again (yes or no).
details: The tools' Redo button can be clicked only while this is true; Redo is the action.

label: Can undo
summary: Whether there is a change in the engine's tools that can be undone (yes or no).
details: The tools' Undo button can be clicked only while this is true; Undo is the action.

label: Redo
summary: Does the last undone change in the engine's tools again; it returns nothing.
details: The tools' Redo button runs it; it also has a keyboard shortcut.

label: Undo history itself
summary: A function on an undo stack that, going by its name, hands back the stack itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type.

label: Undo
summary: Takes back the last change made in the engine's tools; it returns nothing.
details: The tools' Undo button runs it; it also has a keyboard shortcut.

label: Access unique building icon
summary: A function on a unique building's map icon that, going by its name, hands back the icon itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Can construct
summary: Whether the player can construct the unique building shown by a map icon.
details: Vanilla draws the icon half transparent when not, and in the tooltip says "You can construct this Building" or warns that you cannot, as long as it is not built yet.

label: Building type
summary: The building type of the unique building shown by a map icon.
details: Vanilla reads its name and description from it for the icon's tooltip. The game documents no return type.

label: Building effect
summary: A text with the effects of the unique building shown by a map icon.
details: Vanilla shows it under "Effect:" at the end of the icon's tooltip.

label: Is built
summary: Whether the unique building shown by a map icon has been built.
details: Vanilla's tooltip uses it to choose between the can or cannot construct lines (not built yet) and the cannot use warning (built).

label: Is usable
summary: Whether the player can use the unique building shown by a map icon.
details: Vanilla draws the icon half transparent when not, and warns "You cannot use this Building" in the tooltip when it is built but not enabled.

label: Unique building icon itself
summary: A function on a unique building's map icon that, going by its name, hands back the icon itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access unit item
summary: A function on a unit item (an army as shown on the map or in the outliner) that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is another type and only a hint.

label: Army
summary: The army a unit item stands for.
details: Vanilla reads the army's name and its disembark penalty days from it, and makes it the context of the outliner row. The game documents no return type.

label: Background frame
summary: Going by its name, which frame (picture variant) of the unit's background to show.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Unit color
summary: Going by its name, the color of a unit item.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetColor on other types is only a hint. The value is four numbers (a color with transparency).

label: Combat strength
summary: The combat strength of the army as a text, shown on its map icon.
details: Vanilla shows it in the unit templates of the map icon layer.

label: Unit name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a unit item.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetName is common on other types and only a hint.

label: Outliner warning
summary: A warning text shown for the army in the outliner (the list of armies at the side of the screen).
details: What the warning says is not shown in the input. HasOutlinerWarning is likely the matching check.

label: Unit owner
summary: The owner of the army a unit item stands for.
details: Vanilla makes it the context of the map icon so that the owner's realm coat of arms shows. The game documents no return type.

label: Quality level
summary: A whole number for the army's quality, used to pick the frame (picture variant) of its map icon.
details: What the levels mean is not shown in the input.

label: Status text
summary: A text with the status of the army, shown in the outliner.
details: Vanilla shows it in the army's outliner row. What the status says is not shown in the input.

label: Status frame
summary: Going by its name, which frame (picture variant) of a status icon to show for the army.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Supply state frame
summary: A whole number for the army's supply state, used as the frame of its supply icon on the map icon.
details: Vanilla shows the supply icon when the value is above 1, or whenever the map zoom level is below 6.

label: Unit tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text of a unit item.
details: Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetTooltip on other types is only a hint.

label: Tooltip header
summary: A short text shown in parentheses after the army's name at the top of its tooltip.
details: What it contains is not shown in the input.

label: Portrait character
summary: The character whose portrait is shown for the army in its tooltip.
details: Vanilla makes it the context of the portrait in the army tooltip. Which character that is (likely the commander) is not shown. The game documents no return type.

label: Has disembark penalty
summary: Whether the army has the penalty for having recently landed from ships.
details: Vanilla shows a marker on the map icon and in the army tooltip when it does.

label: Has outliner warning
summary: Going by its name, whether the army has a warning to show in the outliner.
details: Vanilla never uses it; GetOutlinerWarning gives the text.

label: Is gathering
summary: Whether the army is gathering.
details: Vanilla shows a gathering marker on the map icon, in versions for the player's own, allied and neutral armies.

label: Is movement locked
summary: Whether the army cannot be moved right now.
details: Vanilla shows a marker in the army tooltip when it is locked.

label: Only hired troops
summary: Whether the army is made only of hired troops.
details: Vanilla shows a different map icon for the player's own armies depending on it.

label: Is retreating
summary: Whether the army is retreating.
details: Vanilla shows a marker on the map icon and in the army tooltip while it retreats, and hides some tooltip parts then.

label: Ruler commands
summary: Whether the army is led by the ruler in person, going by its name.
details: Vanilla shows a marker on the map icon and in the army tooltip when this is true.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the army is currently selected.
details: Vanilla shows its outliner row as pressed and highlights its map icon when it is selected.
